links.outcome: Errors in LLM urticaria answers compared against clinical guidelines
links.effect: DeepSeek-R1 answers contained no errors versus guidelines, while ChatGPT-4o made errors in three clinical questions.
links.quote: When compared with the guidelines, the answers provided by DeepSeek-R1 contained no errors, while ChatGPT-4o made errors in three clinical questions.

screen.reason: The study empirically benchmarks and compares two LLMs (ChatGPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1) on urticaria queries evaluated by dermatologists and non-dermatologists, but it does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
